description: Search Ergin's library of worked AI use cases (support agents, invoice and document automation, sales and lead handling, internal knowledge assistants, MCP servers, legacy rescue and more) for the ones closest to a problem. Pass the problem in plain words, ideally with the systems involved (for example 'supplier invoices arrive by email and get typed into Xero'). Returns the best matches with a one-line summary, the page URL and the typical price range. Follow up with get_use_case for details.

limit.description: How many matches to return, 1 to 10. Defaults to 5.

query.description: The problem or task in plain words, with the systems involved if known.

name: find_use_cases
title: Find matching use cases
